meta.title: Sidebar media player
meta.description: Unified audio and video viewer for the sidebar: mp4/webm/mov and mp3/wav/flac play inline with a draggable Range(206) scrubber, live spectrum and pitch readout, same-name subtitles and lyrics. Adds a player panel (QQ Music online library with favourites synced to the account, local music library) and a capsule bar that can sit above the input box, at the bottom, or be hidden.
